summary: NDPS Act conviction appeal; Section 50 applicability for search of bag vs personal search; mandatory procedural compliance; charas recovery from shoulder bag; High Court reversed acquittal; distinction between SK Raju and Baljinder Singh precedents; presence of independent witnesses disputed.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.20
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.50
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court conviction set aside; acquittal restored due to procedural non-compliance under Section 50 of NDPS Act.
